facts.subject: Acceptance for revenue service
facts.text: Acceptance for revenue service shall require completion of planned test cases, closure of safety-critical defects, successful rollback demonstration, and approval of the operations readiness record.

facts.subject: readiness review authority
facts.text: No open defect shall be accepted for revenue service unless its operational restriction, maintenance response, and passenger impact have been assessed and approved by the readiness review authority.

facts.label: assessed and approved operational restriction, maintenance response, and passenger impact

facts.subject: management
facts.text: Final entry into revenue service shall occur only after management confirms that training, documentation, staffing, spare equipment, monitoring arrangements, and emergency procedures are in place for sustained operation.

facts.label: confirms that training, documentation, staffing, spare equipment, monitoring arrangements, and emergency procedures are in place
